title: Idea Spark
goal: Type your own idea. Bytey will ask you questions to help you think.
mascot_lines: An idea spark is one tiny thought that makes you think 'ooh, what if?'
Sparks usually come from mixing two old things in a brand new way.
Capture them fast — sparks fade in your head if you don't write them down.
